subject: Observability vendor renewal: 3-way proposal & retention add-on tradeoffs
messages:
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Observability vendor renewal: 3-way proposal & retention add-on tradeoffs

Team —

We have renewals coming up across Datadog (APM + infra), Grafana Cloud (logs storage), and Sentry (error platform). I sketched a short proposal in the attached retention_cost_model_v1.xlsx that models three paths:

- Consolidate on Datadog for everything (higher base cost, single vendor simplicity)
- Split: Grafana Cloud for long-term logs (cheaper retention SKU) + Datadog for APM + Sentry for errors (best unit economics but 3 vendors)
- Minimal renewal with retention add-ons only where needed and aggressive log sample/ingest rate cuts (capex-lite but operationally risky)

Ask: please review the model and reply with risk checklist items you care about by EOD Tuesday. Key constraints: SLA for production alerting (APM/trace), legal needs for 12 month raw logs in EU for select customers, and a hard target of 20% reduction in per-token/log unit cost vs last year.

Attachments: retention_cost_model_v1.xlsx (tab: summary, per-SKU breakouts, region splits).

I want a short vendor outreach plan after we align on the target. If we go split, we need to coordinate contracts and an overlap plan (2-week ingestion shadow + indexed retention).

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 21 Feb 2027 12:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewal: 3-way proposal & retention add-on tradeoffs

Rishi —

Quick notes after skimming the model:
- For EU-regulated customers we must keep raw logs for 12 months; Grafana's cold storage SKU is attractive there but confirm egress/legal export guarantees.
- We should add a canary plan: shadow writes to Grafana for 2 teams (payments + auth) for 30 days before cutting over anything. That will surface pipeline issues for retention+indexing.
- Suggest we create a fallback SLA clause with Datadog if we reduce retention there (e.g., 14-day main index + 12-month cold export on Grafana).

I'll mark up the sheet with suggested thresholds and call out which services own which metric.

-Monica
Sr. Product Operations
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Amanda Li <amanda@datadog.com>, Jasper H. <jasper@grafana.com>, Diego Ramos <diego@getsentry.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 08:20:00 -0800
Subject: Request for updated renewal quotes and retention SKU details (Redwood Inference)

Hi Amanda / Jasper / Diego —

We are starting vendor renewals for our observability stack and evaluating three approaches (consolidate, split, minimal). Can each of you provide:

1) A firm 12-month renewal quote for our current scope (APM + infra + logs for Datadog; logs retention for Grafana; error volume tiers for Sentry).
2) Line items for long-term retention add-ons (cold storage, egress pricing, API export costs).
3) Any migration/ingestion credits and term discounts for multi-product deals.

Attached is an internal model (retention_cost_model_v1.xlsx) for context. Our target is to reduce unit costs by ~20% year-over-year while preserving the current alerting and APM fidelity for production.

Please send initial quotes by EOD Wednesday and indicate availability for a 45-minute call to align on migration windows next week.

Thanks —
Ben Carter
Vendor Partnerships, Redwood Inference
Attachments: retention_cost_model_v1.xlsx
From: Amanda Li <amanda@datadog.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Feb 2027 14:07:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Request for updated renewal quotes and retention SKU details (Redwood Inference)

Ben / team —

Thanks for the model. Attached is a preliminary PDF quote (dd_q1_quote_2027.pdf) that includes:
- Standard renewal pricing for APM + Infrastructure + Logging for your current ingestion profile
- Retention add-on SKUs (30/90/365 day tiers) and a Grafana Cold Export integration discount if you commit to a 12-month cross-product deal
- Migration credit: we can offer a $75k ingestion credit if Redwood signs a 12-month consolidated contract by March 31.

Notes:
- Egress: exported logs to a third-party cold store are billed per GB at our published egress rate; we can cap to a negotiated rate if you commit to multi-year terms.
- SLA: we can add an incident response escalation SLA for APM at the enterprise tier (additional add-on).

I can join a call Wednesday or Thursday — preferred: Thu 10:00 PT.

-Amanda Li
Strategic Accounts, Datadog
Attachments: dd_q1_quote_2027.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Observability vendor renewal: 3-way proposal & retention add-on tradeoffs

Team —

After the initial quote from Datadog, my recommendation is:
1) Move logs with retention >90 days to Grafana Cloud (use their cold tier) for cost reasons; request Jasper for a cold-tier SLA and a bounded export/egress rate.
2) Keep Datadog for APM and critical infra alerting for the next 12 months; take the $75k migration credit only if it materially reduces our blended cost after factoring in Grafana fees.
3) Keep Sentry for error sampling and attach a 30-day hot retention there; shift anything older than 30 days to Grafana cold export for long-term search (if Sentry supports export pipeline; Diego — can you confirm?).

Risks: operational complexity (3 vendors), billing reconciliation overhead, and a small window of duplicated ingestion during shadowing. I think a 4-week shadow for payments + auth teams is sufficient.

Action items I propose:
- Ben: schedule vendor calls (Datadog + Grafana + Sentry) and collect final pricing (by Thu EOD)
- Monica: draft canary plan and runbook for shadow ingestion (due Mon 02/29)
- Lauren: coordinate legal on cross-vendor data transfer and egress caps (start intake this week).

I'll draft a short exec note for Finance once we have final quotes.

-Karthik
Director, Infrastructure
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 23 Feb 2027 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Observability vendor renewal: 3-way proposal & retention add-on tradeoffs

Thanks all — good thread. Quick summary and next steps so we don't lose momentum: 

Decision (tentative): pursue the Split approach (Grafana cold for long-term logs, Datadog for APM, Sentry for errors) with a 30-day hot + 12-month cold retention profile. Finalize after vendor calls and confirm that Grafana guarantees egress caps for EU compliance.

Immediate next steps:
- Ben: confirm vendor call times and collect final quotes (due Thu EOD).
- Monica: publish the canary runbook to the shared sheet (link: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/retention-model-2027) and assign owners.
- Lauren: open a legal intake ticket and add egress/processing questions to procurement (DocuSign ref: DS-44210).
- Karthik: prepare an exec note for Finance with blended cost delta (target: -20% YoY).

We'll reconvene Friday for a quick decision after we have the final quotes. If anyone has objections to the split plan, raise them now.

Thanks —
Rishi
Head of Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachments: grafana_cloud_pricing_2027.pdf (ben has the Datadog pdf from Amanda)
